 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if not (all(grid[y][x] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in (c0,c1)) and
                    all(grid[y][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1) for y in (r0,r1)) and
                    all(grid[y][x] == bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1))):
                continue
            ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
            fill = 7 if ih % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
